title: Rate Lock Commitment Extension Request Length: Days to the Estimated Closing Date
content:
## Days asked for on a Rate Lock Commitment extension request

The days an extension request asks for are the calendar days from the lock's current expiration date to the loan file's estimated closing date. A count below zero is taken as zero, because the lock already reaches that date. The result is a whole number of calendar days.

**Inputs and their records**

| Input | Where it is read |
|---|---|
| The lock's current expiration date | The Rate Lock Commitment record, after every extension or relock |
| The loan file's estimated closing date | The Mortgage Loan File record of the file the lock protects |

### Worked examples (hypothetical dates)

| Current expiration date | Estimated closing date | Calendar days between | Days the request asks for |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3 June | 17 June | 14 | 14 |
| 28 June | 3 July | 5 | 5 |
| 10 June | 10 June | 0 | 0 |
| 20 June | 15 June | below zero | 0 |

A count is taken from the expiration date to the closing date. From 28 June to 3 July is 2 days to the end of June plus 3 days in July, which is 5 calendar days.
